title: All-hands: Sam Altman defended OpenAI's DOD deal, saying it was the right decision with "extremely difficult brand consequences and very negative" short-term PR (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Berber Jin / Wall Street Journal: All-hands: Sam Altman defended OpenAI's DOD deal, saying it was the right decision with “extremely difficult brand consequences and very negative” short-term PR — Startup's deal to do classified work with Defense Department drew backlash from staff and other AI researchers
